fct_wait_milestones.content:
name: fct_wait_milestones
description: 'Metric 3: the milestones of the wait between GTA 5 and GTA 6, each with the world real output made since GTA 5 by the day before it. One row per milestone. Population: Every milestone in the wait_milestones seed.'
model: ref('fct_wait_milestones')
defaults:
  agg_time_dimension: event_date
entities:
  - name: milestone
    type: primary
    expr: milestone_id
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
dimensions:
  - name: event_date
    type: time
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
    description: UTC day of the event.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: category
    type: categorical
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: tier
    type: categorical
    description: anchor (the two releases), hero (headline moments) or long.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: title
    type: categorical
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: chart_label
    type: categorical
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
  - name: is_editorial
    type: categorical
    description: 'True for the editorial milestones: the ones drawn on the Metric 3 chart.'
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          null_rule: never
measures:
  - name: output_by_then
    agg: max
    expr: output_by_then
    description: World real output made from GTA 5's release through the day before the event, constant 2015 US$.
    non_additive_dimension:
      name: event_date
      window_choice: max
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: currency:USD
          null_rule: NULL when the event falls outside the wait or the running total is unavailable.
  - name: share_of_wait_output
    agg: max
    expr: share_of_wait_output
    description: 'output_by_then over the whole wait''s output: how far through the wait, in output.'
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          unit: fraction
          null_rule: NULL when output_by_then is.
          additivity: non_additive
config:
  meta:
    dex:
      population:
        rule: Every milestone in the wait_milestones seed.
        parent:
          model: wait_milestones
          key:
            milestone_id: milestone_id
      assumptions:
        - decision: Which day a milestone's output is read on
          chosen: the running total through the day before the event
          evidence: request
          detail: 'user: Metric 3 plan; avoids arguing about events late in the UTC day'
          column: output_by_then
        - decision: GTA 5's own release day
          chosen: output_by_then = 0, not NULL
          evidence: request
          detail: 'user: Metric 3 plan; the day before GTA 5 lies outside the wait, and nothing has been made since GTA 5 yet'
          column: output_by_then
        - decision: Which milestones the chart draws
          chosen: 'the nine flagged is_editorial: comet, AlphaGo, RDR2, black hole, vaccine, ChatGPT, GTA 6 trailer, Claude Code, Artemis II'
          evidence: request
          detail: user named the milestones to keep on the chart and asked for Claude Code
          column: is_editorial
        - decision: Claude Code's date
          chosen: 2025-02-24, the research-preview launch beside Claude 3.7 Sonnet
          evidence: default
          detail: first public release; general availability (2025-05-22) is kept in why
          column: milestone_id
